english: Drake didn't see the king's soldier coming.
korean: 德雷克没有看到国王的士兵走过来。

english: He was busy digging in the onion patch.
korean: 他正忙着在洋葱地里挖土。

english: He pulled out a fat, white onion.
korean: 他拔出一个又大又白的洋葱.
德雷克并不在意那条虫子。

english: He was the son of a farmer.
His family had been growing onions in the Kingdom of Bracken forever.
korean: 他的家族世世代代都在布雷肯王国种洋葱。

english: He would spend his life digging up onions.
whether he wanted to or not.
korean: 他这一辈子都注定要与挖洋葱为伴。
